title: Hong Kong 100 – Transportation (2027)
claims: For HK100, The Half and The Third the start is at Pak Tam Chung in Sai Kung on Tai Mong Tsai Road.
A taxi from Hong Kong Island to the start takes under an hour and costs a little under HKD300, and from Kowloon about 45 minutes and about HKD200.
Bus 92 runs from Diamond Hill MTR bus terminus from 6 am every 30 minutes, and minibus 1A runs from Choi Hung MTR station from 6.30 am leaving when full.
Minibus 101M runs from Hang Hau MTR station from 5.30 am leaving when full.
From Sai Kung Town to Pak Tam Chung, bus 94 runs from 6 am every 30 minutes and minibus 9 runs from 6.15 am every 30 minutes.
GL Tours of Hong Kong is appointed as the official travel services partner for the 2027 Hong Kong 100, providing hotel accommodation and transfers.
The HK100 finish is at Rotary Club Park on Tai Mo Shan Road in Tai Mo Shan Country Park off Route Twisk.

A free shuttle bus runs between the finish and Tsuen Wan MTR station from 5.30 pm on 23 January 2027 to 2.30 pm on 24 January 2027, leaving when full; a later passage on the same page says the service runs from 5.30 pm Saturday to 11 am Sunday.

Tai Mo Shan Road to the finish is closed from 08:00 on 23 January to 17:00 on 24 January 2027, and no participant cars or taxis may access or stay on Tai Mo Shan Road or at the finish during that time.

Bus 51 stops at the junction of Route Twisk and Tai Mo Shan Road about 3 minutes' walk from the finish and runs to Tsuen Wan Railway Station, every 30-40 minutes, but stops at around 11 pm and resumes at 6 am.
CP1 East Dam has its road closed on race days so no vehicles can access the checkpoint.
CP2, CP3 and CP4 are reachable by taxi or public transport and private vehicles need a special permit.
CP5 is reachable by taxi and private vehicles need a special permit.
CP6 is reachable by taxi or public transport with extremely limited parking.
CP7 is reachable by taxi with very limited parking.
CP8 Beacon Hill is generally only accessible on foot, about an hour's hike from the nearest road.
CP9 Shing Mun Dam is car accessible with very limited parking.
CP10 Leadmine Pass is generally only accessible on foot, about an hour's hike from the nearest road.
The page states that the start and CP1 to CP5 also apply to The Half, and that the start, CP1 and CP2 also apply to The Third.
